readme.html:
McPet

A desktop pet that watches your agent sessions, your local token usage, and your lunch.

一只桌宠：盯着 Agent 会话、本机用量，还有你的饭点。

GIFs shipped in this repository under docs/media/deepseek/; sources and licenses are listed in docs/media/deepseek/SOURCE.md.
动画文件就在本仓库 docs/media/deepseek/ 下；来源与许可见 docs/media/deepseek/SOURCE.md。

How to read this page / 怎么读这页 English first, then the same content in Chinese — not a summary, not a separate half. Tables keep both languages in one cell. 每段英文在前、同一内容的中文紧跟在后；不是摘要，也没有单独的"中文版"。表格把两种语言放进同一格。

At a glance · 一眼看懂
Problem
问题		 A long agent run looks the same whether it is working, waiting for input, or already errored — and the token bill lives in yet another window.
长时间运行的 Agent，在工作、等输入、已经出错这三种状态下看起来一样；而 token 账单又在另一个窗口里。
Fix
做法		 A desktop pet + an MCP server over one shared data directory: session state drives the animation, a local ledger tracks usage, reminders fire on a schedule.
桌宠加一个 MCP 服务，共用同一份数据目录：会话状态驱动动作，本机台账记录用量，提醒按时触发。
Cost
代价		 Python 3.10+ and PySide6 for the desktop; the agent path only needs requirements-agent.txt. Dining features need McDonald's / Luckin tokens.
桌面要 Python 3.10+ 与 PySide6；只走 Agent 路径只需 requirements-agent.txt。餐饮功能需要麦当劳/瑞幸凭据。
Not
不是		 Not a hosted service, not a model provider, not an ordering bot that pays for you.
不是托管服务，不是模型提供方，也不是替你付款的下单机器人。

What it does · 能做什么

Feature · 功能 Desktop entry · 桌面入口 Say this to the agent · 对 Agent 说
Companion & skins
陪伴与换装		 Character & actions → default / McD outfit "DeepSeek 娘穿麦麦套装"
Session state
会话状态		 Sessions & quota → session progress "用 McPet 看当前会话状态"
Usage & balance
用量与余额		 Sessions & quota → local ledger, Orca cache, DeepSeek balance "余额还有多少"
McDonald's
麦当劳		 McDonald's → coupons, store, live quote "今天有什么麦当劳优惠？先查一下"
Luckin coffee
瑞幸		 Luckin → store, item, spec, preview price "选一杯拿铁，先预览价格"
Nutrition ledger
营养记账		 Nutrition → pick item, confirm servings "查询巨无霸营养，我吃了 1.5 份"
Reminders
定时提醒		 Settings → time & location → lunch / coffee "饭点改成 12:15"

Every order, coupon claim and ledger write shows a concrete summary first and waits for explicit confirmation. The default order guardrails are 100 CNY per order and 3 orders per day, re-checked at confirmation time.

每一次领券、下单和记账都先展示具体摘要，等明确确认后才执行。默认订单护栏是单笔 100 元、每日 3 单，确认时再复核金额。

The problem · 问题在哪

An agent session is a black box with a progress bar:

agent  ──▶ working?          (no output for 6 minutes)
       ──▶ waiting for input? (a prompt is on screen)
       ──▶ stopped?           (idle / Stop)

idle and Stop are session states, not success. The pet shows the state it can actually read from logs or host events, and keeps unreadable fields unknown instead of guessing.

Agent 会话是个带进度条的盲盒：

agent  ──▶ 在工作？        （六分钟没有输出）
       ──▶ 在等输入？      （屏幕上有提示）
       ──▶ 已停止？        （idle / Stop）

idle 与 Stop 是会话状态，不是成功。桌宠只显示它真能从日志或宿主事件读到的东西，读不到的字段保持未知。

The idea · 思路

Noun · 名词 Path · 路径 Rule · 规则
Pet src/pet/, src/main.py --desktop Animation follows real state; a missing sprite falls back to an existing action rather than a broken frame.
动作跟随真实状态；缺素材时回落到已有动作，不出现破图。
Host src/agent_mcp.py, src/agent_install.py The MCP server is started by the host over stdio; the desktop pet is a separate process on the same data directory.
MCP 服务由宿主以 stdio 启动；桌宠是另一个进程，共用同一份数据目录。
Progress src/progress/, src/agentbridge/ Session progress comes from readable logs and host events only; idle is not success.
会话进度只来自可读日志与宿主事件；idle 不等于成功。
Guard src/mcd_mcp/, src/luckin.py Order, claim and ledger writes require an explicit confirmation step.
下单、领券与记账都需要显式确认步骤。
Ledger src/metering/, src/accounts/ Every number carries its source and update time; unknown stays unknown.
每个数字都带来源与更新时间；未知保持未知。

Quickstart · 快速开始

1. Portable release (no Python needed) · 便携包（免装 Python）

Download McPet-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip, unzip the whole folder and double-click Start-Pet.vbs. If the launcher misbehaves, run .\McPet.exe --desktop in that folder.

下载 McPet-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip，解压整个文件夹后双击 Start-Pet.vbs。启动脚本不可用时，在解压目录运行 .\McPet.exe --desktop。

2. Connect your agent · 接入 Agent

The host needs MCP stdio support. From the agent package directory, or from a source checkout:

宿主需要支持 MCP stdio。在 Agent 包目录或源码目录运行：

python -m pip install -r requirements-agent.txt
python -m src.agent_install

Put the printed server.command / server.args into the host's MCP settings, name it mcpet, transport stdio. Portable-package users can run .\McPet.exe --install for the same output.

把输出的 server.command / server.args 填进宿主的 MCP 设置，服务名 mcpet，传输方式 stdio。便携包用户可运行 .\McPet.exe --install 得到同样的连接信息。

3. From source · 从源码运行

python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m src.main --desktop

Regression checks used by this repository:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_deepseek_skins.py tests/test_agent_host.py tests/test_guards.py -q
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q src scripts tests

The commands above are copied from CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/USER-GUIDE.md; none of them were re-run while writing this page.

以上命令抄自 CONTRIBUTING.md 与 docs/USER-GUIDE.md；写这页时没有重跑任何一条。

Documentation · 文档

Doc · 文档 Read it when · 什么场景读它
docs/USER-GUIDE.md You need install, menus, account setup, dining flows, FAQ.
需要安装、菜单、账号配置、餐饮流程与常见问题。

首次启动 Windows 便携包或 Agent 包。

在接 MCP 宿主：工具、资源、宿主事件。

需要可移植技能副本与其引用文件。

要改代码：环境、检查、提交规则。

需要当前进度、分支归属、待验收事项。

要复用素材或参考代码——先看各自的许可。

Repository layout · 仓库结构

mcpet/
├── src/
│   ├── pet/            # desktop pet window, sprites, behaviour
│   ├── agent_mcp.py    # MCP stdio server for the host
│   ├── agent_install.py# prints server.command / server.args
│   ├── progress/       # session state from logs + host events
│   ├── metering/       # local token ledger
│   ├── accounts/       # read-only quota / balance sources
│   ├── mcd_mcp/        # McDonald's client, business rules, order guard
│   ├── nutrition/      # local nutrition ledger
│   └── schedule/       # reminders
├── .agents/skills/     # portable agent skill source
├── assets/             # sprites, GIFs, credits
├── docs/               # user guide, agent docs, release notes, media
├── integrations/       # optional native adapters (OpenCode)
├── scripts/            # release build, asset import, diagnostics
└── tests/              # 38 pytest files

Status · 状态

Shipped release: v0.1.0, Python/Qt, Windows x64 portable. The Tauri 2 + original-art redesign is still at M0 (docs/contest/M0-REPORT.md). Source is 70 Python modules; tests are 38 files.

现行发行：v0.1.0，Python/Qt，Windows x64 便携包。Tauri 2 与原创形象的重做仍在 M0（docs/contest/M0-REPORT.md）。源码 70 个 Python 模块；测试 38 个文件。

Known limits, stated rather than hidden:

  • The v0.1.0 download still needs your own McDonald's / Luckin tokens; token-free trial only works from current source (.env.trial).
  • macOS and Linux desktop/tray compatibility has not been fully accepted; only the agent path is cross-platform today.
  • Desktop reminders need the pet running; agent reminders need host activity.
  • python -m pytest -q has known open failures in legacy desktop and foreground-performance items; the curated regression set is the one the repo claims.
  • No CI workflow exists in this repository, so nothing is checked automatically on push.
  • Real-account orders, payments and full host conversations still need human acceptance.

边界写出来而不是藏起来：

  • v0.1.0 下载包仍需自备麦当劳/瑞幸凭据；免 Token 试用只在当前源码（.env.trial）可用。
  • macOS、Linux 的桌面与托盘兼容性尚未完整验收；目前只有 Agent 路径是跨平台的。
  • 桌面提醒依赖桌宠运行；Agent 提醒依赖宿主活动。
  • python -m pytest -q 在旧桌面与前台性能相关项上仍有已知失败；仓库只对整理出的回归集作承诺。
  • 本仓库没有 CI 工作流，push 时不会自动检查。
  • 真实账号下单、付款与完整宿主对话仍需人工验收。

License · 许可

This repository declares no project-wide license at its root — there is no top-level LICENSE file. Per-asset and per-reference licenses are recorded in assets/CREDITS.md; the only LICENSE file in the tree is assets/dsh-deepseek/LICENSE, which covers that asset only. Treat the code as all-rights-reserved until the author states otherwise.

本仓库根目录没有项目级许可——没有顶层 LICENSE 文件。各素材与参考代码的许可记录在 assets/CREDITS.md；树内唯一的 LICENSE 是 assets/dsh-deepseek/LICENSE，只覆盖该素材。在作者另行声明前，代码按保留所有权利对待。
